### The Jews Complete the Temple
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/jews-complete-the-temple
Passage: Ezra 6:13-22
Points:
- God demonstrates His sovereignty by working through unexpected and pagan leaders to accomplish His purposes.
- The temple's completion reflects divine concurrence, where God ordains outcomes that unfold through human actions.
- Although the dedication and Passover involved fewer sacrifices than Solomon's temple, the people still obeyed and rejoiced.
- Believers are called to faithful obedience in seasons of humble beginnings, trusting God with the results.
